translations.web: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you?
translations.bsb: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
translations.kjv: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
translations.asv: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? Shall they that are decreased arise and praise thee? Selah
